text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Kggghhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I can't reach...? Is it... not enough!?
Even with the strength given to me by my dear sisters...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Is the radiance we aspired to achieve...
only this much...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I cheer with all my might for Mejiro Bright, whose legs almost stopped for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(—!? That is right, I am
Mejiro Bright. I am a Mejiro...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(If I go down, the Mejiro name sinks with me. Indeed,
the sun is not meant to merely receive light—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Something that shines with its own light!
I, I myself will...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Toward the Mejiros' new ideal!
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a striking contrast. Mejiro Bright, who had seemed on the verge of sinking,
regained her brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Silence Suzuka crossed the finish line
listlessly, as if something had thrown her off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, dear sisters?
The Mejiro name... The Mejiro name is alive and well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today, I have become the radiance of Mejiro itself!
Ah, what immense pride...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah, Suzuka-sama...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~. Thanks to you,
I was able to push my running even further today...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's wonderful.
Truly great. But as for me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't run my own race. No,
I felt that I shouldn't. Because..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because I felt it. If things continue like this, my scenery will be swallowed whole by your brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can't reach it with this run.
It's surely just a little bit different...
I just can't shake that feeling...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~?
Well then, next up is...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll review it once more.
My own running. And—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I shall pursue the light as well.
A light different from yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Until we meet again someday,
Lady Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san, um... Welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan... I'm sorry...
I'm just a little...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was being self-centered. Let's try
paying a bit more attention to the scenery around me, and try once more...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. But before that...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Will you watch my run?
This time, I want to run!
Alongside Bright-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have returned.
It was all thanks to your voice~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I managed to wake up somehow.
And I was able to realize something truly important.
choice_data_list: If my voice reached you, then I'm glad...
I'm just glad my voice reached you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In this way, Mejiro Bright acquired a running style that could rival even that of Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer, there are plenty of other Umamusume who possess next-generation speed like Suzuka-sama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must see for myself whether this new Mejiro
truly resonates with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If I'm going to test it, the stage should be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Arima Kinen...
The year-end Grand Prix~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am looking forward to it. I will surely make that day a new memorial day for the Mejiros...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Bright headed toward the Arima Kinen as the representative of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Against such a vast array of talented and renowned Umamusume,
we must showcase the brilliance of a new era."
